correctness.rationale: Vertex-transitive three-round EF criterion: identical collections of adjacency-plus-third-point spectra are necessary and sufficient. For each cycle power, 00 is absent iff both intervertex circular gaps <=2r+1; 11 follows explicit common-neighbor tests; exclusives fail only for the antipodal false-twin pair when n=2r+2, as shown by the exact common-neighbor count for nonedges. These cases generate ten pairwise distinct rows and prove the infinite classification. A rank-three domination sentence witnesses every claimed sharp boundary. Two structurally different finite checking programs reproduced the indicated tests from packaged files.

value.rationale: Natural and complete two-parameter phase diagram: ten exact rank-three classes for all noncomplete cycle powers, with six regimes for genuine graph powers and one radius-independent stable tail. Sharp thresholds have geometric meaning in pair domination and common-neighbor distances. This is a motivated classification of what three first-order moves detect across varying graph orders and degrees, not a special-value recomputation.
